invariance_proof: For every N event n, delta(q,n)=q for q=(b,r,f,s,d).
By induction, inserting any finite number of N events anywhere leaves the final five-bit state unchanged.
Permuting only N events also leaves state unchanged because identity transitions commute.
Therefore traces differing only by insertion/deletion/reordering of N have the same authoritative projection, NF, and verdict.
Duplicate precedence is preserved because no N can set or clear d; any authoritative duplicate still sets d and forces FAIL.
The proof does not reorder B/R/F/S/D; singleton timing relative to F remains semantically significant.
bounded_leaf_result.minimality: N carries zero checker state and can be quotient-erased. The five evidence bits suffice for verdict; s must remain a qualified post-finality bit so pre-final singleton observations cannot create PASS.
bounded_leaf_result.first_falsifier: Any purported N that actually changes b/r/f/s/d, or any pre-final singleton allowed to set s, falsifies the quotient. Any authoritative duplicate sets d and forces FAIL.
